contracts.title: Human move is visibly rendered before AI calculation begins
contracts.requirement: When the learner selects a legal move, the board must visibly show that player move before the AI calculation starts.
contracts.source: User-requested gameplay requirement, captured after repeated rendering regressions on 2026-09-29.

contracts.title: Selected piece and AI thinking state are visibly indicated
contracts.requirement: When the learner selects a legal piece, the selected cell must have a clear visual marker and legal destination cells must be distinguishable. After the learner's move is submitted, the board must show an explicit AI-thinking overlay until the AI response completes or an error state is recovered.
contracts.source: User-requested gameplay feedback requirement, reconfirmed after live verification on 2026-09-30.

contracts.title: Six public AI levels remain selectable with distinct search profiles
contracts.requirement: The browser trainer must continue exposing six selectable AI levels whose documented search profiles remain materially different; actual playing-strength ordering is validated separately through the calibration benchmark.
contracts.source: User-requested AI level progression requirement, preserved for future engine-strength work.

contracts.title: Trainer is a scroll-free single-screen web app
contracts.requirement: The primary trainer experience must fit within the browser viewport without page scrolling. The match board remains the visual center, while settings, assessment, analysis, review, and training stay within fixed-height application regions.
contracts.source: User-requested product UI direction, confirmed on 2026-10-01.

contracts.title: Game-first layout does not let auxiliary surfaces cover the board
contracts.requirement: In the normal trainer screen the board, turn/status context, and essential actions are the primary visible surface. Settings, analysis, review, and training open only through explicit controls and consume application layout space rather than overlaying the board.
contracts.source: Superseded by explicit user-requested setup-first/replay-modal UI flow on 2026-10-02.

contracts.title: Setup-first game flow with minimal in-game surface
contracts.requirement: The board must not be shown before game setup is completed. Initial entry presents a separate difficulty/side setup screen. During play, only the board, turn/player context, compact move evaluation, and essential actions remain visible. Starting a new game opens the same setup flow as a modal over the current game, and review/training remain post-game actions rather than persistent in-game surfaces.
contracts.source: Explicit user-requested product UI direction, confirmed and browser-verified on 2026-10-02.
